description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Turkish Tactician Style, 7 ranks in Sense Motive, 3 ranks in Spellcraft or 3 ranks in Use Magic Device

Benefit: While in Turkish Tactician Style and in melee range of a spell caster, you are treated as if you have the Disruptive feat. If you perform a successful Assessment against a creature that can cast spells, you can apply your insight bonus to all saves against that creature's spells and spell-like abilities.

system.requirements: Turkish Tactician Style, 7 ranks in Sense Motive, 3 ranks in Spellcraft or 3 ranks in Use Magic Device
